tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i man ngag sbas pa mig 'byed sogs bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti pra dzā bh+yaḥ dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i man ngag sbas pa mig 'byed ces bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam shes rab thabs sbyor ba/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi'i longs spyod rdzogs sku mchog / rgyal ba yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /bde chen mgon po khyod kyis shis par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud rgyal ni/ /dgyais pa'i rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /lhan cig skyes pa rab sgrub la/ /rim pa gnyis po rgyal gyur cig /sems can kun la snying brtse bas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras ster ba/ /bla ma bzang la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sbyin bsreg med cing dka' thub med/ / yod pa med cing med pa med/ /rtag dang chad pa rab bral ba/ /'dir ni bya ba'i las kun spangs/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor can yang med/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems shes rab tu brjod/ /de na sngags bzlas de dka' thub/ /sbyin bsreg dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor can/ /mdor na sems bsdus tshul can no/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /sangs rgyas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas/ /bde chen mgon po'i drin las bshad/ /lus can rtog pas sgribs pa las/ /ye shes gsal bar 'gyur ba med/ /rnam rtog mun pa zhes bya ste/ /rnam par rtog med gsal ba yin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum ldan pa/ /ye shes lnga mi rtsibs dang ldan/ /'khor lo bskor bya de las gzhan/ /rang rig skad cig rtag pa la/ /dus gsum spangs pas bsgom bya ste/ /rang rig gcig pus thams cad byed/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /gcig dang du ma yod ma yin/ / gang zag rang bzhin med pa ste/ /bsam du med pas bsgom par bya/ /rang bzhin med pas sgom pa ste/ /'di ni de kho na nyid yin/ /de nas bskyed rim bla ma'i gsung*/ /mkhas pas dran pa gcig tu bya/ /ngo bos gzugs med mthong so med/ /sgra med nyan pa po yang med/ /dri med snom pa po yang med/

/ro med myong ba po yang med/ /reg med reg pa po yang med/ /sems med sems pa po yang med/ /de nas phra mo dang thig le bsgom ste/ snying ka'i dbus na zla ba gnas/ / zla ba'i dbus na mi shigs pa/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis rnam 'khrigs ldan/ /des ni rdo rje rnam par bsgoms/ /gzhan yang*/ mkha' 'gro rdo rje bdag med ma/ / bskul ba'i cho gas sgom par bya/ /mkha' 'gro gdong gi sna rtser ni/ /nyung kar gnas pa rnam par bsgoms/ khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i/ /'gro ba ma lus nyung kar du'o/ /de nas gong bu bsdu ba ste/ /'od gsal ba'i ye shes kha dog 'jig par bsgom mo/ /nag po dmar dang ser dang ljang*/ /sngon po dkar po yan lag drug /phyi nas kha dog spangs pa ste/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyi/ /lha sku kha sbyor nyi zla dang*/ /yi ge mi phyed bcings pa yi/ /don dam par ni rab tu bsgoms/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i 'od gsal ba'ang*/ /rnam pa 'di yis sgom bya ste/ /dga' bral mthar yang mtshon par bya/ /sprin dang nam mkha' snang byed dang*/ /smig rgyu de nas sgron ma dang*/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bur snang*/ / de nas dkyil 'khor sgom par bya/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i go rim de kho na nyid bzhi la gnas nas yan lag drug sgom pa'o/ /de la dran pa gcig pa ni/ so sor bsdud pa'o/ /thig le'i rnal 'byor dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor/ kha dog bshig pa'i sbyor ba ni bsam gtan yin te/ ldang ba dang 'jug pa'am/ yang na kum+bha kas 'bar ba dang 'dzag pa 'dir yang man ngag gis shes par bya'o/ /thig le bsam pa ni rtog pa'o/ /phra mo'i dkyil 'khor thig le de'i nang du chud pa ni sbyor ba'o/ /bdag med ma 'bar bas yid dga' ba ni dga' ba'o/ /nor bu'i thig le ni bde ba ste/ yang na lte bar bde ba g.yo ba med par 'byung ngo*/ /gzugs las 'das pa ni rtse gcig pa dang 'brel ba'i shes rab bo/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i go rim ni gzhan bshad de/

de nyid bzhi po dag las/ /dang por bdag gi de nyid ni/ /de las thig le sgom bya ste/ /rang byin rlabs pa rab tu 'grub/ / gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg byar mngon ldan zhing*/ /rnal 'byor nyid kyis der bsam na/ /de dag bdag dang gzhan med par/ /rdo rje pad ma las byung bzhin/ /yang dag bde ba dngos mchog de/ /rba rlabs med cing snang ba med/ /rnam par rtog med 'gyur ba med/ /cung zad chang la rab zhugs te/ /bdag med ma la rang rig gzhag /bral ba'i dga' ba dag gi mtha'/ / rnam par rtog pa dang bral zhing*/ /mi g.yo rnam par 'khrul med pa/ /dgyes rdor zhes bya'i dngos po gsal/ /dang po nor bu'i thig le ste/ /de nas snying gar sgom par bya/ /nor bu dang snying ga'i sna rtser zla ba dmar po la hūṃ zhes bsam mo/ / rim pa gnyis kar 'di sgom ste/ /rdzogs pa'i lha ru gsal ba yin/ /de nas sngags kyi de nyid bshad pa/ mtshan ma lnga mthong nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes 'jug pa dang ldang ba dang gnas pa la/ dkyil 'khor bzhi las mi shigs pa'i sngags bzlas pa dang*/ dbang po'i lam las kyang de ltar bshad de/ mig dang yid kyi bar du mngon par shes pa drug tu 'gyur ro/ /bde ba gnag cing bde ba ser/ / bde ba dmar po bde ba dkar/ /bde ba ljang khu bde ba sngo/ /bde ba rgyu dang mi rgyu kun/ /nag po sngon po dbang po drug khyab byed zhes pa gzhan yang ni/ /'di yis yul rnams rnam pa drug /rgyu dang mi rgyu bde bar byed/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob cing*/ /yid kyi mngon shes drug pa'ang 'byung*/ /ā li kā li'i rab brtags pas/ /rdo rje'i bzlas par yang dag bshad/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sems kyi dngos po rnam par bsgom/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sku'i yi ge rnam par sgom/ /dkyil 'khor dmar po'i dbus gnas par/ /rin chen sems kyi yig 'bru dgod/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/

/gsung gi yi ge rnam par sgom/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /don yod gzugs can yi ge dgod/ /nyi ma khrag dang khu ba ste/ /mi shigs sems kyi dngos por brjod/ /rlung rnams gsal ba dang bde bar gyur pas/ rdo rje dang thod pa'i ā li'i sa bon las steng dang 'og dang so sor bzlas pa bya'o/ /rdo rje thod pa'i sbyor ba ste/ /thod pa gsang ba'i lte ba ru/ /rdo rje smin ma'i 'khor lor brjod/ /steng dang 'og tu bzlas pa bya/ /srog dang rtsol ba'o/ /'dzin pa'i ye shes bskyed par byed pa ni/ de nas mdor bstan pa/ /chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang*/ /mar me'i 'od ni rab bcings ltar/ / rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor gyis/ /nyin dang mtshan du mkhas pas spyad/ /dpal ldan de bzhin nyid gshegs shing*/ /de bzhin slar yang bshegs pa nyid/ /rim pa 'di nyid rgyas par bstan pa la 'jug pa/ 'dir ni khu khrag mi phyed pa/ /mar me lta bu 'og tu brtag /hu lu hu luṃ hūṃ sgra sgrogs/ /byed cing thig le 'od 'dres pas/ /rang snying thig le rtag tu sgom/ /rlung 'gog gtum mo sbar ba las/ / sregs dang byin gyis brlabs par bya/ /lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sreg cing*/ /spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs te/ / bsregs pas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /sgrub bya ji lta'i gzugs te dpyid/ kha ni 'og tu rnams sgom zhing*/ /gsang ba'i laṃ du khab ni me'i/ /gzugs can 'jug par bsam par bya/ khrag dang khu ba'i 'du 'khrod skyug /'dar zhing mgo skyes grol ba'o/ /snying ga'i byin zar thim pa las/ /phung po'i rnam rtog bsad par bya/ /ga bur nyid ni bdag med ma/ /bde ba bdag med rang bzhin can/ /de yi bde ba phyag rgya che/ /dang po'i dbyangs kyi rang bzhin te/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor yang dag gnas/ /blo zhes sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /lte ba'am gsang ba las/ las kyi rlung gis sbar ba'i tsaṇ+ḍa līs de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdud rtsi zla ba'i 'od zer lta bu dgug par byas nas bsgom pa 'dis ni/

dga' ba bzhi thob ste/ sgo dgu 'gag go /'khor lo bzhi 'gag go /sgo gnyis dbye'o/ /phyi dang nang gi snyoms 'jug la/ /gnas gnyis nas ni snying gar 'jug /chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya yang de'o/ /de nas phyag rgyas srog rtsol byed/ / rang byin brlab pa gnyis pa'ang brjod/ /shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma/ / ring thung ma yin lang tshos brgyan/ /sngo bsangs sih+la ga bur ldan/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos med na/ /rang 'dod lha'i rigs kyis bya/ /yang na shin tu sbyangs pas so/ /gar ma tshos ma rdo rje ma/ /gtum mo de bzhin bram ze mo/ / thabs dang shes rab cho ga yis/ /de nyid rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /dbyer med mtshan nyid kun grub na/ /phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor 'grub par 'gyur/ /rigs lnga'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ /thar pa'i rgyur ni brjod par bya/ /rdo rje 'dis ni gdab pa nyid/ /des na phyag rgyar brjod par bya/ /skye byed ma dang sring mo nyid/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /ji ltar bye bar mi 'gyur bas/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsten pa nyid/ /ma gsang sbrul dang chom rkun dang*/ /sa spyod me yi sdug bsngal byed/ /de la mngon par rtogs pa ni 'di yin te/ phyi'i bu mo rang gi rigs can yongs su sbyangs la/ de kho na nyid dang*/ lha'i gzugs la yi ger bcas pa ji ltar bye bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar sgom mo/ /rdo rje'i mdun du lag bzung nas/ /'khyud dang 'o byed mnye pa dang*/ /lte ba'i rtsa ba lag pas dbye/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rab gzir bya/ /rdo rje gsor mo'i rab sbyor gyis/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi rab bskul te/ /phyis nas de yi bde ldan du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab bcug ste/ /rdo rje bcings pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje mchod pa rab tu brtsams/ /rdo rje sems su rab phyung la/ /rdo rje lce yis bza' bar bya/ /de nyid rgyas par bstan pa ni/ nyams dga'i rol pas kun du lta zhing de rjes sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i tshig 'jam dang*/

/dga' ba'i dri bsung lag pa'i mtsho skyes brkyangs nas de la kun 'khyud pa'i/ /chags pa'i ro 'thung gcod dang gzhal bas bdag kyang ci 'gyur ma shes te/ /g.yon g.yas khu rdul rab 'bab g.yon gyi dbus gnas rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma/ /bha ga kurma'i dbus su sor mo gsum/ /yang na khong nas sid kyi sgra byung ba/ /ji srid lce yi thur mas bskul byas nas/ /de nas chos khams bde ba 'di la sgrub/ /sbyor ba de las byung ba yi/ /ga bur mkhas pas mi spang ngo*/ /gang gang 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba/ /de de thabs dang bcas pas grol/ /mnar med 'gro ba sgrol ba'i phyir/ /de nyid mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mtha' dag /nges pa'i thabs kyis lhan skyes rig /bde ba rab bde chags bral dang*/ /skad cig bzhi yi rab sbyor las/ /de nas bzhi pa sgom par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i phyogs la ni/ /'di ltar lhan cig skyes rnam bzhi/ /gang phyir 'byung ba che bde ba/ /de phyir bde ba de nyid min/ /lhan skyes dag las gang skyes pa/ /de ni lhan cig skyes par brjod/ khyab dang khyab byed tshul gyis ni/ /bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa nyid/ /mchog mtha' dga' bral dang po can/ /mun pa la ni mar me ltar/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di la thabs dang shes rab med/ /yang dag de nyid snang ba'o/ /khu ba'i rnam pa bcom ldan yin/ / de ni bde ba 'dod mar brjod/ /gcig dang du ma'i skyon bral 'di/ /skad cig gcig las mchog dga' ba/ /rang gi rig pa'i ye shes 'di/ /ngag gi lam gyi spyod yul 'das/ /skad cig bzhi dang bcas pa las/ /dga' ba bzhi po mtshon par bya/ /'di ni byin brlab rim pa'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu/ / dbang po las 'das dbang po thams cad pa/ /skye med nyid na'ang rang rig spyod yul can/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin ngag las 'das/ /chu 'dzin stug po mtha' ru thim pa bzhin/

/'di las 'gro ba thams cad byung*/ /'di las gnas gsum po yang byung*/ /'di yis thams cad khyab pa ste/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin gzhan ma mthong*/ /bza' dang btung dang blugs pa dang*/ /nyal dang log dang sems pa na/ /de ni sngon du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sa chu rlung dang me nam mkha'/ / rang gzhan rig pa'i tshor ba ni/ /kun kyi skad cig gnod mi 'gyur/ /rang gzhan cha yi rnam rtog gis/ /gnon pa nyid ni nus pa min/ /las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /yang na snying gnas nyams dga' ba'i bu mo phyung ste spyad do/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /'khor lo bzhi la dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba na gzugs las 'das pa bsgom ste/ 'di dag thig le 'dus las mthong*/ /gzung 'dzin thig le gsum thim pas/ /dngos po kun kyi rang bzhin mthong*/ /de nas chu klung lta bur bsgom/ /rig ma dang lhan cig ye shes gsum mngon du gyur nas don dam par 'gyur ba yin no/ /ye shes kyi phyag rgya la yang 'di sbyar te de kho na nyid sgom mo/ /de'i mtshan ma lnga mthong zhing*/ /ye shes des gzung ba dang 'dzin pa bsad nas/ /de las langs pa na/ chos brgyad ni rang bzhin med pa'i phyir mnyam la/ /nyon mongs pa'i tshogs dang gnod pa thams cad dang*/ /dge ba gang gi yang mi brdzi bar de nyid dang*/ /bde ba thob pa rgyun mi 'chad na dro ba thob pa zhes bya'o/ /'di las kyang smig rgyu la sogs pa 'byung ba yin no/ /ye shes 'di la bskal ba'am bskal pa stong du yang sbrang bu dang*/ rnga bo che dang*/ mtshon dang*/ me dang*/ char pa la sogs pas mi 'phrogs shing*/ bde bas mnyam par bzhag go /phyag rgya chen mo'o/ /de dag ni gzung ba'i yan lag go /de ltar rdo rje'i phyag rgya las/ /mi phyed bde ba lha skur 'gyur/ /brtan gyur don dam bsgom nas kyang*/ /phyi nas spyod pa yang dag spyad/ /de nyid rgyas par bstan pa ni yang bshad par bya ste/ bde ba dngos dang dngos med bde/

/rdo rje sems dpa' bde bar brjod/ /dang po sprin dang 'dra bar gnas/ /grub na sgyu ma lta bur 'gyur/ /gnyid log sad pa dbyer med bzhin/ /rtag tu rmi lam lta bur snang*/ /sgom med sgom pa po yang med/ /lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin/ / spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin las/ /sngags dang lha ni yang dag gnas/ /ji ltar shes pa'i bde chen po/ /bde ba shes rab bde ba thabs/ /'di ni kun du ru skyes bde/ /dam pa'i bde ba'i de nyid de/ /bde ba rtogs phyir rnam sangs rgyas/ /gang phyir lus byung lha zhes brjod/ /ji ltar sgyu ma rmi lam dang*/ /ji ltar bar ma'i srid pa ltar/ /dkyil 'khor nyid ni de bzhin 'dod/ /bsdus dang gnyid log chos kyi sku/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mngon du byed/ /mgrin par rmi lam longs spyod kyi/ /'khor lo zhes bya sku ru brjod/ /lte ba spyi bo nas snying gar/ /ye shes sku ni sprul par brjod/ /gang phyir yid kyis lam bsgom par/ /'gro ba thams cad sgom par bya/ /rig pa lhan cig goms byas pas/ /phyogs kun na da'i khams su bsdu/ /sku dang sems ni grub par 'gyur/ /de lta na dpe'i 'od gsal las ni bde ba chen po'i sems myos pa/ rlung dang lhan cig pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom mo/ /byis pa rnams kyi rmi lam dang*/ srid pa bar ma zhes bya ba/ ye shes kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan pa/ bcad du med pa/ de bla ma dam pas nye bar ma bzung ba'i phyir 'khor ba zhes bya la/ de nyid bla ma'i drin gyis mgrin par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'gyur ro/ /rjes su dran pa'o/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du stong par 'jug ste/ rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ /sbyor ba 'di ni rab brtsams na/ /skya rengs char ba'i dus su ni/ /'grub pa 'di la the tshom

med/ /rang rig mā ma kīr byas te/ /rdo rje pad+mas spyad par bya/ /bde chen rdo rje rab grub 'gyur/ /rig ma'i nang gi bde ba lnga po sgrubs nas/ ji ltar 'dod pas sems mi 'khrugs pa/ de ltar spyod lam de lhan cig don dam pa sgom pas/ dpe las 'das pa thob par byed do/ sems 'khrugs pas ni g.yengs shing nyon mongs te/ nyon mongs sdig pa de yis dmyal bar 'gro /goms pa de yis bag chags bgo ba ste/ /grogs dag sems ni mi g.yengs 'khrug mi bya/ /rim pa 'di ltar gnyid stug po dang*/ mthar dus byed pa dang*/ 'khrig pa'i sbyor ba dag la/ rlung rnams kun dhar du thim zhing*/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'gros zad pa dang*/ ye shes gsum rang bzhin la 'jug ste/ srid pa ldog pa yang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gis snying gar chos kyi sku zhes mngon du 'gyur ro/ /btsun mo'i bha gar ston pa'i sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan gtso bo/ /sku gsum mi phyed rdo rje yi/ /ye shes rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /gang stong pa de las ldang ba ni/ /bar ma chod par lha'i rang bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i 'bras bu de nyid/ /ye shes gsum gyi mthar 'od gsal dang gnyis su med pa ste/ rim pa de ltar gnyid sad pa dang*/ /skyes bu dang bud med dbang po gnyis sbyor ba'i bde ba las ldang ste/ ji ltar gnyug ma'i lha dang*/ sems kyi rang bzhin bde ba de/ de nas yang glau bur gyi lus la 'jug ste/ bla ma'i man ngag gis lte bar sprul pa'i sku'o/ /byis rnams rtag tu 'di la goms byed cing*/ /'di rnams kho na'i gtam dang gtam gyis 'da'/ / 'on kyang mi shes 'dod la chags de rnams/ /yang yang rnam par smin pas 'khor bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang*/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ / ye shes dkyil 'khor sgom par bya/ / dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam du/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sgom par bya/ /'bar chen sna tshogs 'od zer la/

/sangs rgyas sprin rnams sna tshogs mdzes/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal bar/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal la dmigs bya/ /de nyid phyir ni sgom pas ni/ /sems can thams cad dang mnyam 'gro/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor 'gyur te/ /'khrungs dang byang chub la sogs pa/ /skyes gnas yongs su 'dzin mdzad dang*/ /'jig rten 'dul bar gzigs nas ni/ /'di ni du ma'i gar mdzad do/ /snying rje'i gzugs kyis don mdzad de/ /phyag rgya grub pas 'gro bar 'gyur/ /chu shing snying po med pa la/ /'bras bu mngar mo 'byung ba ltar/ / lus kyi chu shing bshig pa las/ / 'bras bu rtag pa 'di 'byung ngo*/ /he ru ka dngos bem po min/ /rnam pa lnga rnams rab spangs pa'i/ /bdag nyid mgon po he ru ka /nyid du rang rig med par de/ /skad cig de la thams cad 'gyur/ / 'di ni rdul med khu khrag med/ /'on kyang bde ba zhes bya ba/ khu ba zhes bya'i rnam par gnas/ /de med pas na bde med 'gyur/ /bde ba med na de med 'gyur/ / bde chen grub pas 'jig par 'gyur/ /nus pa med phyir ltos dang bcas/ /dngos dang dngos med 'di la med/ /mtho ris mi yul sa 'og rnams/ /skad cig gis ni sku gcig 'byung*/ / brtan g.yo ma lus bdag rang bzhin/ /dam pa'i de nyid bsgom par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o/ /cung zad drod ni yang dag thob/ /gal te spyod pa byed 'dod na/ /gal te dngos grub thob 'dod pas/ / 'dis ni spyod pa rgyu bar bya/ /zla ba gcig tu gsang la spyad/ /phyi nas smyon pa'i spyod pa bya/ /sha za lta bur 'khyam pa'am/ /yang na nang gi bdag nyid kyis/ /zla phyed yang na zla ba drug /kun du bzang po'i spyod pa bya/ /dngos med 'byung ba'i bde ba lnga/ /don dam par ni sgom par bya/ /rtag pa rin 'byung snang byed dang*/ / rta mchog dges rdor rdzun pa'i dngos/ /rang rig bu mor longs spyod bya/

/ gnyis med dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ / sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ / rim pa dang po'i dngos grub byed/ /gnyis pa gnas sogs sgrod pas ni/ /rtsa yi mdud pa 'joms pa ste/ /rlung dang thig le'i 'gros dang gzhan/ /'od gsal sgom pas dag par 'gyur/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i las dang po pa dang rim pa dang po bas rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal ba zhes rtogs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi sku grub pas ni/ dkyil 'khor dang dbyer med par sgom nas 'dod pa thams cad la ci 'dod par spyad na/ phyag rgya'i dngos grub tu 'gyur te/ de'i phyir lus la mi smad cing mchod par bya'o/ /gnas la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor mas/ /'dir ni sgrub kyi gzhan du min/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i don rgyas pas/ /mngon par byang chub 'bras bu thob/ /de ltar bla ma'i man ngag bslabs pas rig ma dang lhan cig gnyi ga'ang ltos pa med bar mngon par byang chub lngas 'dod pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /bdag gi de nyid thig le ste/ /sgrub pa sngags kyi de kho na/ /kun rdzob bden pa lha zhes bya/ /ye shes don dam dag tu brjod/ /bud med nges pa'i phyag rgya che/ /ye shes dam tshig las rnams te/ /gnyis med bdag nyid mi phyed pa'o/ /yan lag phyi ma dag gi phyag rgya bzhi ni/ gnas gsum gyi mi mo dang*/ ye shes sku kha sbyor dang*/ de kho na nyid dang*/ ye shes kyi sku chen po rnams ni/ las dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ chos dang*/ phyag rgya chen po rnams so/ /the tshom 'gyod pa gnyid dang ni/ /le lo rgod dang gnod sems can/ /nam yang 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te bde chen 'grub 'gyur ba/ /ye shes 'di nyid la btad pas/ /dngos grub thams cad nye ba yin/ /'dir ni man ngag nyid bsdus kyis/ da ni rab tu mi spro ste/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gi /rgyud sde dag ni mnyan par byos/

/mang du smras pas ci zhig bya/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /rnal 'byor gcig bu sgom gyur na/ /'phral du mngon du byed ba nyid/ /rnyed bkur med par rjes su bzung mdzod ces 'dod de nyid thob ma thagardo rje'i rgyud rig da lta nga shes slob dpon gyi yang thog mar smra/ /mchog gi mi dmod chang dang bud med nor la rab chags bla ma la/ /mnyam par 'gran byed mi la dpal chen rdo rje sems dpa'ang 'jigs zhes gsung*/ /de 'dra dpa' po'am rang gi bu/ /de yi chung ma skal ldan na/ khyim gcig tu yang mna' ma la/ / smra yi de la 'bad nas gsang*/ /skal bzang bla ma la rab gus/ /zab mo'i chos dang sdom la gnas/ /de ni tshong 'dus dbus gnas na/ /shub bur yang ni de nyid bshad/ /gzhan gyi dbang byed la bdag po/ /rnam par g.yengs tshe de nyid sbyin/ /ngan pa de la ming tsam yang*/ /brjod par mi bya grogs dag kyai/ /dpal sde lwa ba dril bu'i zhabs dang po/ /bde chen lus med mtsho skyes gnyis pa yin/ /de gnyis las ni rje btsun 'bar ba 'dzin/ /pad+ma mi bdag lak+ṣ+mī gsum pa ste/ /'phags pa rdo rje can zhabs de sras dang*/ /skal bzang mo ni bzhi par brjod par bya/ /kah+na brtul zhugs zhabs dang ku sā la/ /de yis byā da lar ni yang dag bshad/ /smras pa/ mi srun rjes su bzung na gnyi ga nyams/ /blo bzang thams cad bde ba'i 'bras ldan pas/ /'dis ni rnal 'byor brtson par sgrub pa la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin du don bcas yin/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob dpon gsum gyi gzhung gsum gas lam tshang ba re ston rung*/ rim bzhin rtsa ba kha skong mtha' gcod rnams su don gyis gnas pa/ bla ma'i man ngag ltar go rim sdebs nas gcig tu byas pa sbas pa mig 'byed ces bya ba ku sā la'i zhabs kyi rjes su slob pa kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gcig tu nye ba na myos byed kyi lo la dpal bsam gtan sdings kyi yang dben du sbyar//

// mtshams sbyor ba yi tshig 'ga' las/ /rang rtog lhur len 'dir ma byas/ /mtshan ma rnyed nas bshad pa yi/ /dge bas 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /maṅga lam/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla 'od nyi 'od nyi nub smag /snang ba gsum gyi phyi yi dpe/ /skya rengs 'char dus sgrib med ni/ /phyi yi mngon byang 'od gsal des/ /mngon byang chub pa'i khyad par dus/ /nyi nub thob pa rab 'das nas/ /'od gsal 'char ba nang gi ni/ /mngon byang nyid du shes par bya/ /de rgyu rig mas mngon byed pa/ /rdo rje khu ba nyi ma rdul/ khu ba nyi ma'i gnas son pa/ /de yang dbu mar nub pa na/ /lhan skyes mi 'gyur skya rengs 'char/ /mngon byang dngos dang dpe yang 'grub/ /'bras bu'i mngon byang zhes bya lnga/ /thabs shes gnyi ga'i khu ba yi/ /tshogs pa phra mo zhu ba ni/ /zla ba nyid yin rdul dang 'dres/ /nyi ma'o phra mo'i rlung sna rtser/ /son pa mtshan ma yin par brjod/ /rlung thim khu khrag kyang thim pa/ /thams cad gcig gyur nan tan yin/ /de yi yang dag mthar zhugs te/ /longs skur rdzogs pa lnga pa yin/ khu ba 'bab thim snang ba dang*/ /rdul dang 'dres thim mched par bshad/ /rlung thim snang ba nyer thob pa/ /gsum pa zhig tshe thams cad stong/ /phyi ma gtan nas thim pa yin/ /dang po gsum gyi skabs su ni/ /nub pa snying gar thim zhing zad/ /ngo bo sna rtser gshegs pa yin/ /phyi ma las brtan snying ga ru/ /tshogs pa zhig nas thim pa'o/ /dang po gsum gyis bzang rtog dang*/ /phyi mas 'dzin pa'i bag chags bcom/ /shes sgrib phra mo'ang rab log nas/ /chos sku mngon du byed par 'gyur/ /sems ni skya rengs chos sku la/ /lus ni mi slob dag pa'i sku/ /rig mar lhan cig 'grub par gsungs/ /rang 'od kyis kyang 'grub mod kyi/ /phyi yi phyag rgyas rab sgrubs na/ /gnyi ga'ang rgyud gcig bzhin du grol/ /lus kyi khu khrag rlung dag pas/ /rlung sems 'gyur med longs sku dang*/

/sems 'gyur gnyis snang thim pa las/ /chos sku bde stong 'gyur med thob/ /'phros don rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du/ /don 'grub 'gul bskyod 'byung rngub dang*/ /sems g.yo med las rgyal bas skul/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ma mthong la/ /sngags gsungs sems ni rang bzhin med/ /stong nyid bcu drug so sor rtogs/ /kun gzhi'i rang bzhin stong pa ni/ /stong nyid bcu drug rjes thob tu/ /ā li bcu drug las bzla bar/ /bskyed nas rtogs tshad phul ba ni/ /dang po'i de las 'od gsal ba'i/ / sems bskyed rjes thob yang bzla ba'o/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'o 'od gsal ba/ /glau bur dri ma med pa'i ming*/ /gsum pa gzung bya mi dmigs pa'i/ /stong nyid rjes thob rdo rje'o/ /bzhi pa 'dzin byed ye shes kyang*/ /mi dmigs sangs rgyas kun byin rlabs/ /lnga pa longs spyod rdzogs rtag pa/ rim bzhin mi bskyod rin chen 'byung*/ /snang byed don grub rnam snang mdzad/ /rigs lnga'i sngags rgyas sgrub par byed/ /dang po'i gzung 'dzin rags pa spongs/ /gnyis pas bag nyal gsum pa yis/ rjes thob rtog pa'ang rab spangs nas/ /bzhi pas stong pa'i ye shes spongs/ /chos sku mngon byed lnga pa yis/ /rnam kun mchog ldan chad mtha' spangs/ /gnyis kyis bsod nams gsum pa yis/ /ye shes tshogs rdzogs bzhi pas ni/ /chos dang lnga pas longs sku sgrubs/ /zag med phung po nyi shu lnga/ / gzugs phung gnas gyur bde bshegs lnga/ /tshor ba gnas gyur ting 'dzin lnga/ /'du shes gnas gyur gdam ngag lnga/ /'du byed gnas gyur spangs ba lnga/ / rnam shes gnas gyur rtog pa lnga/ /'dir ni phyogs mtshon tsam smos kyi/ /zhib par tshad ldan rnam bshad las/ /ma gtogs ji bzhin rtogs dka' 'o/ /rgyud sde'i zab gnad rtogs dka' ba/ /mdo tsam mtha' gcod bris pa yi/ /dge bas he ru kar gyur nas/ /'gro kun rdo rje sems grub shog /ces pa 'di rdo rje nyi ma sogs kyi don rdo rje nyi ma'i don rgyas pas zhes ma gtogs rgyas bshad cher ma byung ba de'i mtha' gcod zhib bshad du 'phros dang bcas bris pa rab gsal ye shes kyi spyan zhes bya ba kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas dben gnas dam pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas chen bsam gtan sdings su rang lo nyer gcig nye ba la sbyar ba'o//
//bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i man ngag sbas pa mig 'byed sogs bzhugs/ - PAGE 214 -- PAGE 215 -- PAGE 199 -
